channel.title: Japanese Patterns Daily
channel.description: One Japanese sentence pattern a day, explained in English as a formula (A wa B desu = A is B), built up piece by piece, then used in a short dialogue with slow / normal / repeat drills and a real-Japanese news corner. Works entirely by ear. Voices: VOICEVOX:冥鳴ひまり, VOICEVOX:玄野武宏, Kokoro.

item.title: #11 たのしい しゅみ — A Fun Hobby
item.description: Pattern: A N ／ B な N (A N / B na N) = an A N / a B N (the adjective comes before the noun, just like in English) Topic: hobbies Tip: Never put な after an い-adjective: it's あつい コーヒー, not あついな コーヒー. Memory trick: い-adjectives stand on their own; な-adjectives need な to hold the noun's hand. And な only appears in front of a noun. Before です, it's just しずかです. Real Japanese (morning weather report): きょうの とうきょうは さむい あさです。 = Tokyo is having a cold morning today. New words: しゅみ (hobby), りょうり (cooking), たのしい (fun, enjoyable)

item.title: #10 けんの かぞく — Ken's Family
item.description: Pattern: AはBです／AはBじゃないです (A wa B desu / A wa B ja nai desu) = A is B / A isn't B (B = a na-adjective) Topic: family Tip: きれい ends in an い sound, but it's a な-adjective, so its negative is きれいじゃないです, never きれいくないです. A memory trick: な-adjectives act like nouns (add です or じゃないです), and い-adjectives change their own ending (〜くないです). Real Japanese (TV weather forecast): 明日の天気は不安定です。 = Tomorrow's weather will be unstable. New words: かぞく (family), おかあさん (mother), おとうさん (father), げんき (healthy, energetic, doing well (な-adj)), しずか (quiet (な-adj)), きれい (pretty; clean (な-adj))

item.title: #9 コンビニ — At the Convenience Store: It's Not Expensive!
item.description: Pattern: AはBくないです (A wa B-kunai desu) = A is not B Topic: at the convenience store Tip: Don't put じゃないです after an い-adjective (たかいじゃないです is wrong). Nouns take じゃない; い-adjectives swap their final い for くない: たかい → たかくないです. Exception: いい (good) → よくないです. Real Japanese (TV weather report): あしたの東京はあつくないです。 = It won't be hot in Tokyo tomorrow. New words: コンビニ (convenience store), おにぎり (rice ball), おいしい (delicious, tasty), あつい (hot), つめたい (cold (to the touch))

item.title: #8 この シャツは かわいいです — This Shirt Is Cute! (Shopping and Prices)
item.description: Pattern: AはBです（B＝い形容詞） (A wa B desu (B = an i-adjective)) = A is B (B = a describing word like cute, expensive, cheap) Topic: shopping for clothes and asking prices Tip: The final い is part of an い-adjective, so never drop it: たかいです, not たかです. Think of い as the adjective's little tail that always stays on. Also remember word order: the describing word comes first and です always comes last. Real Japanese (TV weather report): あしたのとうきょうは、さむいです。 = Tomorrow, Tokyo will be cold. (Literally: As for tomorrow's Tokyo, it is cold.) New words: シャツ (shirt), いくら (how much (price)), えん (yen), たかい (expensive), やすい (cheap), かわいい (cute)

item.title: #7 しゅうまつの よてい — Weekend Plans — "Me Too!" with も
item.description: Pattern: AもBです (A mo B desu) = A is also B / A is B, too Topic: weekend plans Tip: も replaces は. Don't say both (no 'わたしはも'). Think of も as a 'me-too' sticker you put on the new topic, and the rest of the sentence repeats what was already said. Real Japanese (TV weather report): あしたの東京も雨です。 = Tomorrow, Tokyo will have rain too. New words: しゅうまつ (weekend), やすみ (day off / holiday), よてい (plan / schedule), えいが (movie), どようび (Saturday), にちようび (Sunday)

item.title: #6 えきで しつもん — Where Is the Toilet? Asking Questions at the Station
item.description: Pattern: Aは なん／どこ／だれ ですか (A wa nan / doko / dare desu ka) = What / where / who is A? Topic: asking for directions at a station Tip: Don't move the question word to the front like in English. Put it right where the answer will go: トイレはどこですか → トイレはあれです. Also, "what" is なに, but before です it becomes なん: say なんですか, never なにですか. Real Japanese (TV quiz show host): では、もんだいです。このどうぶつはなんですか。 = Okay, here's the question. What is this animal? New words: えき (station), トイレ (toilet / restroom), でぐち (exit), どこ (where), 何 (what), だれ (who)

item.title: #5 これは あさごはんです — This Is My Breakfast
item.description: Pattern: これはAです／このAはBです (kore wa A desu / kono A wa B desu) = This is A / This A is B Topic: morning routine Tip: これ／それ／あれ stand alone, but この／その／あの always need a noun right after them. Never say これパン. Say このパン, or これはパンです. Memory trick: the の in この is like the linker の, and it always needs a noun after it. Real Japanese (store announcement): このケーキは、本日のおすすめです。 = This cake is today's recommendation. New words: それ (that (near the listener)), あれ (that (over there)), この (this (+ noun)), あさごはん (breakfast), パン (bread), かさ (umbrella)

item.title: #4 私の コーヒーですか — Whose Coffee Is This?
item.description: Pattern: AのB (A no B) = A's B / the B of A Topic: at a restaurant Tip: Owner first, always. の works like English apostrophe-s: whatever comes before の owns or describes whatever comes after it. けんのケーキ is Ken's cake. Flip it to ケーキのけん and you've said 'the cake's Ken'. When English uses 'of' (the menu of the restaurant), turn it around in Japanese: みせのメニュー. Real Japanese (TV weather report): あしたのとうきょうのてんきです。 = Here is tomorrow's weather for Tokyo. (Literally: It's tomorrow's Tokyo's weather.) New words: ともだち (friend), みせ (shop / restaurant), メニュー (menu), ケーキ (cake)

item.title: #3 学生じゃないです — I'm Not a Student
item.description: Pattern: AはBじゃないです (A wa B ja nai desu) = A is not B Topic: self-introductions Tip: The negative ending じゃないです replaces です. It doesn't come after it, so never say "desu ja nai desu." And because "not" comes at the very end in Japanese, always listen to the last word to know whether a sentence is yes or no. Real Japanese (TV weather report): あしたは雨じゃないです。 = Tomorrow, it won't be rain. New words: 学生 (student), せんせい (teacher), かいしゃいん (office worker / company employee), 日本人 (Japanese person), アメリカ人 (American (person))

item.title: #2 今日は あめですか。 — Is it rainy today?
item.description: Pattern: AはBですか (A wa B desu ka) = Is A B? Topic: the weather today Tip: か is a question mark you can hear. You don't change the word order or add a separate word for 'is'. Just take any AはBです sentence and put か at the end. To answer, start with はい (yes) or いいえ (no). Real Japanese (radio host asking the weather forecaster): では、しゅうまつは はれですか。 = So then, will the weekend be sunny? New words: 今日 (today), あした (tomorrow), あめ (rain), はれ (sunny weather), くもり (cloudy weather), いいえ (no)

item.title: #1 私はコーヒーです — I'll Have Coffee
item.description: Pattern: AはBです (A wa B desu) = A is B (literally: as for A, B is it) Topic: ordering coffee at a café Tip: は (wa) means "as for" and marks the topic. It doesn't mean "equals." So 私はコーヒーです (watashi wa koohii desu) means "As for me, coffee," which is how you say "I'll have coffee." It does not mean "I am coffee." Memory trick: です (desu) is like a full stop. It always comes last and closes the sentence. Real Japanese (TV weather report): 今日、東京は晴れです。 = Today, it's sunny in Tokyo. (literally: today, as for Tokyo, it's sunny) New words: 私 (I, me), コーヒー (coffee), おちゃ (tea (green tea)), これ (this (thing near me))
